laptop, commander · fleets home (default), work ·
  app shop → fleet home (the fleet recorded for app shop) · env feat-x

caramelo builds, tests, runs, deploys and operates applications from a single
caramelo.yaml, on machines it sets up itself: isolated environments for every
branch, previews on real hostnames, production with gated deploys and one-command
rollback, and a fleet of machines behaving as one.

It is built for agents first. Every command has --json output, stable exit codes
and never waits on a terminal, so an agent can drive it from a shell; a person
types the same commands. 'caramelo manual' is the reference for this machine,
and 'caramelo manual --role all' for every role there is.

Usage:
  caramelo [flags]
  caramelo [command]

Available Commands:
  app         Inspect the applications on the machine
  build       Build a release: one image per service, from a commit
  commander   The machine you type on: name it and write the files it needs
  config      Inspect the effective caramelo.yaml of an app
  connect     Open local ports for an environment's services and dependencies
  context     Say where this CLI is running and what a command typed here would act on
  deploy      Deploy a release to an environment, with gates and a way back
  down        Stop an environment's services, keeping its dependencies and data
  edge        The machine's public edge: routes, certificates, targets
  env         Create, inspect and destroy isolated environments of an app
  events      Everything the machine does, whoever started it
  fleet       Manage the fleets this commander talks to
  help        Help about any command
  hub         Commands the machine itself runs: setup, uninstall, status, run
  key         Manage the SSH keys allowed to use the API
  logs        Show an environment's service logs, merged and prefixed
  manual      The manual of this machine: every command that holds here, with examples
  member      Inspect this machine, and the fleet it is part of
  peer        Manage the identities allowed on the machine's network
  promote     End a deploy's watch: stop the old replicas and prune
  releases    An environment's deploy history, or the app's releases
  rollback    Put the previous release back
  run         Run a command in the app's toolchain inside an environment
  secrets     The machine's vault: scoped secrets, encrypted at rest
  status      Show whether caramelod and Docker are up, and how we reached them
  test        Run the app's tests inside an environment
  up          Start an environment's services and wait for them to be healthy
  version     Print the caramelo version
  vpn         Join a machine's private network

Flags:
      --fleet string      fleet to talk to, by its name in the commander config (default: the app's fleet, then the default fleet)
  -h, --help              help for caramelo
      --json              print machine-readable JSON on stdout
      --machine string    raw ssh target to talk to, for a machine that is in no fleet yet: user@host[:port], or 'local'
      --progress string   how progress is written to stderr: text (default) or json, one event per line

Use "caramelo [command] --help" for more information about a command.

6 commands are hidden here; 'caramelo manual --role all' lists every command of every role.
